paper_title: First results from a microwave cavity axion search at 24 micro-eV
coupling_convention: |g_agammagamma| in GeV^-1, plotted as values on a 10^-14 GeV^-1 linear axis (multiplier applied)
notes: First results from the Yale microwave cavity haloscope (HAYSTAC). New measured exclusion limit: |g_agamma| >~ 2e-14 GeV^-1 excluded over 23.55-24.0 ueV (5.7-5.8 GHz, TM010 mode), equivalent to |g_gamma| >~ 2.3x KSVZ on average, at >=90% CL with ~4% uncertainty. Assumes isothermal halo with rho_a = 0.45 GeV/cm^3 and velocity dispersion 270 km/s.
